/financial/banking: Checking/savings statements, bank notices, checks, ACH/direct-debit authorizations
/financial/credit-cards: Credit card statements, agreements, card notices
/financial/credit-reports: Credit reports, monitoring, inquiries, security freezes
/financial/loans/mortgage: Mortgage statements, escrow analyses, servicing transfers, payoff letters, 1098s from servicers
/financial/loans/heloc: Home equity line of credit statements and agreements
/financial/loans/auto: Vehicle loan statements, payoffs, financing agreements
/financial/loans/other: Personal, equipment (e.g. John Deere) and other installment loans
/financial/taxes/returns: Income tax returns, e-file authorizations (8879), amended returns, IRS notices and transcripts
/financial/retirement: 401(k), IRA, pension, ESOP account statements and plan notices
/financial/investments: Brokerage statements, dividends, stock plan statements
/financial/hsa: Health savings / medical spending account statements
/financial/bills/utilities: Electric, gas, water, sewer, garbage bills
/financial/bills/other: Other bills not covered by a more specific tag
/financial/invoices: Invoices and quotes/estimates for goods or services
/financial/payroll: Pay stubs, payroll notices, bonus statements
/medical/visits: Visit summaries, checkups, well-child visits, procedures, surgery, discharge instructions
/medical/lab-results: Lab, pathology, radiology and test results
/medical/eob: Explanation of benefits / claim statements from a health plan
/medical/dental: Dental care records, treatment plans and dental bills
/medical/forms: Consent, release, sports physical and other medical forms; medical history and records requests
/insurance/health: Health plan enrollment, coverage, COBRA, ID cards, plan notices; also vision plans
/insurance/home: Homeowners and landlord policies, declarations, renewals, claims
/property/purchase-sale: Purchase agreements, closing/settlement statements, escrow, appraisals, deeds, title, reconveyance
/property/improvements: Remodels, construction, architectural plans, permits, contractor proposals
/property/maintenance: Repairs, home services, appliances, HVAC, landscaping, pest control
/vehicles/registration: Registration, renewals, titles, emissions, purchase and trade-in documents
/vehicles/tolls-parking: Toll bills, parking receipts and passes
/legal/contracts: Agreements, NDAs, service contracts; also wills, trusts and powers of attorney
/legal/business-entity: LLC/corporate formation, EIN, UBI, business licenses and registrations, corporate governance
/legal/notices: Data breach, privacy and other legal notices
/work/employment: Offers, HR, compensation, promotions, reviews, resumes, separation
/work/benefits: Employer benefits enrollment and plan notices
/work/stock-compensation: RSUs, options, ESPP, ESOP grants and transactions
/work/projects: Project and client deliverables: reports, memos, drawings, proposals
/education/school-records: Report cards, assessments, testing, enrollment, school fees
/education/childcare: Daycare and preschool enrollment and billing
/travel/bookings: Itineraries, flights, hotels, rental cars, cruises
/personal/identification: Vital records, IDs, passports, marriage certificates, voter registration
/personal/government: Social Security, DOL and other government correspondence
/personal/correspondence: General letters not covered by a more specific tag
/personal/purchases: Product manuals, warranties, registrations, license keys
/activities/sports: Youth/adult sports registration, recruiting, team documents
/activities/events: Tickets, concerts, events, scouting and other group activities
